name: @agentpulselabs/cli-plugin-pulse
description: oclif plugin that adds the `pulse` topic (portable, contract-enforced build discipline) to the agentpulse CLI. User-installed: `agentpulse plugins install @agentpulselabs/cli-plugin-pulse`. A thin argv→core seam over @agentpulselabs/pulse.

pulse.description: Run a contract-enforced build discipline engagement (Discovery → Stories → Architecture → Build → Deliver).
